{{nihongo|'''Tanaka'''|たなか}} is the fourth most common [[Japanese name|Japanese]] surname. It is typically written with the [[kanji]] for {{nihongo|ricefield & middle|田中}}.<ref>{{cite press release|title=明治安田生命 全国同姓調査 [''Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company - National same family name investigation'']|publisher=[[Meiji Yasuda Life|Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company]]|date=2008-09-24|url=http://www.meijiyasuda.co.jp/profile/news/release/2008/pdf/20080924.pdf|accessdate=2019-03-09}}</ref> Less common variants include {{nihongo|many & middle|多中}}, {{nihongo|many & relationship|多仲}}, {{nihongo|another & middle|他中}}, {{nihongo|shelf & low|棚下}}, {{nihongo|shelf & summer|棚夏}} and {{nihongo|many & name & congratulation|多名賀}}.{{Citation needed|date=March 2021}}
